configurations.name: pecan-fixture
runtimeArgs: set -e; ROOT="$PWD"; S="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/pecan-dev"; mkdir -p "$S/agent/sessions" "$S/project"; export PECAN_AGENT_DIR="$S/agent"; export PECAN_PI_ARGS="--no-extensions --extension $ROOT/scripts/fixture-model.ts --provider pecan-fixture --model fixture-v1"; cargo build --quiet -p pecan; ./target/debug/pecan add "$S/project" >/dev/null; exec ./target/debug/pecan serve --port 7615 --no-open

configurations.name: pecan-web-dev
runtimeArgs: cd web && PECAN_API_TARGET=http://127.0.0.1:7615 exec npx vite --port 5714 --strictPort

configurations.name: pecan-seeded
runtimeArgs: set -e; S="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/pecan-test-ground"; cargo build --quiet -p pecan; ./target/debug/pecan seed "$S" >/dev/null; export PECAN_AGENT_DIR="$S/agent"; for p in "$S"/repos/*; do mkdir -p "$p"; ./target/debug/pecan add "$p" >/dev/null; done; exec ./target/debug/pecan serve --port 7616 --no-open
